The MSDF generator, which builds the atlas of a font file ahead of time or at its first load.
Learn: [Custom fonts and MSDF](/use/learn/going-further/fonts/), [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Coloring`](/reference/tools/coloring/) | class | Gives the edges of an outline the channels of the distance field, so that the corners stay sharp. |
| [`Edge`](/reference/tools/edge/) | class | A segment of an outline, linear, quadratic or cubic, with the channels it contributes to. |
| [`FontFile`](/reference/tools/fontfile/) | class | The tables of a TrueType or OpenType file, read for the weight, the style and the kerning that the font of Java does not give. |
| [`GlyphEntry`](/reference/tools/glyphentry/) | class | One glyph of an atlas being generated: its code point, advance and outline, then its place and size in the atlas. |
| [`Glyphs`](/reference/tools/glyphs/) | class | Reads the glyphs of a font with the font of Java: codes, advances, line metrics and outlines. |
| [`Kerning`](/reference/tools/kerning/) | class | The kerning pairs of the requested code points, read from the `GPOS` table or the `kern` table of a font file. |
| [`Msdf`](/reference/tools/msdf/) | class | Computes the multi-channel signed distance field of an outline. |
| [`MsdfGenerator`](/reference/tools/msdfgenerator/) | class | Generates the MSDF atlas of a font file, as a `font.msdf` file that JOID loads without generating it again. |
| [`MsdfWriter`](/reference/tools/msdfwriter/) | class | Writes a `font.msdf` file: the face, the metrics, the glyphs, the kerning and the distance field, compressed. |
| [`Packer`](/reference/tools/packer/) | class | Places the glyphs of an atlas in rows and finds the largest glyph size that fits. |
| [`Shape`](/reference/tools/shape/) | class | The outline of a glyph, as closed contours of edges. |
| [`SignedDistance`](/reference/tools/signeddistance/) | class | A signed distance from a point to an edge, with its orthogonality to break ties. |
| [`Vector2`](/reference/tools/vector2/) | class | An immutable 2D vector of the MSDF generator. |
